versions.changelog:
klickanalytics-cli 1.0.3

- Updated skill metadata to use `requires.env` and `primaryEnv` for environment variable definition.
- Removed legacy `compatibility.runtime` field for improved configuration alignment.
- No changes to commands, features, or documentation content.

klickanalytics-cli 1.0.2

- Added explicit compatibility metadata specifying `clawdis` runtime and required environment variable (`KLICKANALYTICS_CLI_API_KEY`)
- Updated publisher formatting in SKILL.md
- No changes to CLI commands or functionality

Initial release. Covers all 25+ ka commands including quote, prices, earnings, 
ta, ta-signals, earnings-moves, ai-chat, quantstats, volatility, and more. 
Includes agent/LLM integration patterns, OpenClaw automation guide, and 
global coverage of 100,000+ symbols across stocks, ETFs, crypto, FX, and indices. 
Built by ex-Bloomberg professionals at KlickAnalytics.com.
